description: Public scenarios only; expected observations and evaluator bindings remain hidden.

invariants: purchase eligibility is derived from PaymentAvailability and the billing product returned for the service-provided LoginConfiguration.playProductId
the client does not replace the service-provided product ID or the billing-formatted price with caller input
initialization may discover eligibility and price but never starts or completes a purchase
the purchase launcher crosses to the UI layer because only that layer owns an activity
the spinner remains visible while the external purchase sheet is unresolved
no success, failure, redemption, or navigation is inferred before PurchaseFlowCompleted supplies the held result
cancellation is a settled outcome rather than an error dialog
the payment screen remains retryable after the held spinner is cleared
a cancelled sheet produces no receipt request and no account mutation
ServiceUpdating is non-terminal and therefore leaves the Purchase option recoverable
returning from the operating-system remediation rechecks availability rather than trusting stale state
price loading is observable before the recovered available price
the Play purchase identifier is exchanged for a verified receipt credential and is not sent as the registration credential
fresh receipt-based registration supplies neither phone identity nor PNI key material
the purchase is consumed and its persisted context cleared only after account registration succeeds
the Registered event precedes navigation so SignalLoginInfo observes the issued ACI and account entropy pool
phoneNumberless is derived from the successful registration response having e164 null
SignalLoginInfo clears the pre-registration back stack and no phone-verification or PIN route is inserted
confirmation compares both locally entered credential halves with the ACI and account entropy pool already held by RegistrationFlowState
a mismatch flags both fields because either half may have been copied incorrectly
editing either field clears areCredentialsIncorrect and makes a corrected retry reachable without recreating the account
SkipClicked is only a request and never completes registration by itself
dismissing the confirmation leaves the user on AddUsername with registration still incomplete
only AddUsernameScreenEvents.SkipConfirmed may convert this pending choice into RegistrationComplete
the conflicted custom-discriminator path can recover to a valid custom reservation before this event
clearing a user-chosen discriminator invalidates its exact reservation immediately and cannot confirm the erased pairing
a fresh service-assigned reservation becomes reachable only after AddUsernameScreenEvents.DiscriminatorFocusLost, preventing the focused-field race
restoration is proven through the application production blob store and a newly created repository, not a retained object or in-memory fake
the retry reuses the byte-identical receipt credential request context because the service rejects a different request for the same purchase
an already-owned unconsumed purchase is redeemed without launching or charging a second purchase

passwordManagerStoredCredential.password: display form of new account entropy pool

invariants: the production navigation collector invokes SignalCredentialManager.saveCredential with the uppercase ACI and displayed account entropy pool, then routes its result back to the owning SignalLoginInfoViewModel
a successful save is not trusted until the user confirms and SignalCredentialManager.getCredential returns a credential filtered by that same account ID
the read-back username is normalized to an ACI and the password is parsed as an AccountEntropyPool before comparison
only an exact two-part match advances to AddUsername; null or mismatched read-back remains on SignalLoginInfo with dialogs.saveNotConfirmed and can recover through another save or manual recording
